text:
maria: uploaded a quick Figma for the rollout snapshot modal — https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ (private). main things i want feedback on: 1) where should focus land when the modal opens? heading or close button? 2) avoid duplicate screenreader announcements (timeline emits live region when snapshot created). 3) escape / return-focus behavior. any quick thoughts?
eden: heading + role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" feels right. focus the heading so VO users land on the title, then they can tab to actions. focusing the close button is surprising for screen-reader users. also add aria-describedby that points to the short summary paragraph.
tareq: agree on heading focus. for the duplicate-read issue: timeline has a live region that announces the new snapshot. if modal opens immediately we get two reads. option A: set aria-hidden on the timeline while the modal is open so SR only sees modal. option B: mark the modal summary with aria-live="polite" and let the timeline be quiet. A might be simpler.
kyle: small ux nit — CTA copy "Rewind to this version" is verbose on narrow screens. could be "Rewind" with a tooltip/aria-label providing the full context. also make sure the snapshot pill has a visible focus ring — keyboard testing lost it in Chrome.
maria: good call. on aria-hidden: be careful to not remove focusable elements from DOM without trapping focus first. behavior plan: 1) trap focus inside modal, 2) set aria-hidden="true" on the timeline container while modal open, 3) on close, return focus to triggering pill. thoughts?
eden: that sequence is fine. just ensure we preserve inertness for the background (inert polyfill) so screen readers and pointer events are blocked. aria-hidden alone sometimes leaves focusable elements active for AT.
tareq: +1 to inert or aria-hidden + tabindex=-1 for focusables. implement a data attribute on the triggering pill (data-snapshot-trigger-id) so we can .focus() it on close. also add a short timeout before returning focus if we animate close, otherwise VO focus jump is odd.
design-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: A11Y-1723 created (assign: eden, tareq) :white_check_mark:
maria: question about duplicate content: timeline announces "snapshot created: v3 — canary 10%" and modal heading repeats "Snapshot v3" — should we suppress one? maybe modal heading could be slightly different: "Snapshot details — v3" so it reads as context rather than repetition.
kyle: I like "Snapshot details — v3". shorter CTA variants: "Rewind" / "Abort canary" / "Apply patch" depending on state. state-driven copy table in Figma would help.
eden: keyboard flow: enter opens modal, focus goes to heading, user tabs: heading -> description -> primary CTA -> secondary CTA -> close button. escape closes and returns to pill. ensure tabindex order matches visual order (we had a mismatch in last build).
tareq: accessibility edge-case: if modal opened from timeline keyboard nav (arrow keys), the triggering element might not be a focusable pill (could be a node in a virtualized list). add fallback logic to store the last focused element before opening modal and restore that.
maria: noted — will add a small snippet to the design handoff notes with fallback logic: 
```
// on open
lastFocused = document.activeElement;
openModal();
// on close
closeModal();
(lastFocused || document.querySelector('[data-snapshot-trigger-id]')).focus();
```
this will be in the dev notes.
kyle: css nit — modal max-height should be 80vh so user still sees timeline context behind it for orientation. also increase contrast on the snapshot stat numbers (current 2.8:1).
maria: i'll update Figma: heading-focus pattern, aria-describedby id, variant CTA states table, and the dev snippet. will also add a small motion note: fade-in 120ms, fade-out 80ms; we'll use a 50ms delay before returning focus to avoid the VO flicker.
eden: can we add an aria-live region inside the modal summary for status updates (like canary traffic)? set aria-live="polite" on the summary so if the canary progresses while modal open, SR announces it.
tareq: yep — make sure the live region is specific (aria-atomic=true for the stat container), not the entire modal. otherwise SR will re-read huge sections.
maria: thanks all — i'll post the updated figma link in ~30m. will also tag design-bot to add checklist entries for focus-trap, inert, return-focus, and live-region specifics. :sparkles:
kyle: quick follow-up: do we want an explicit "keyboard only" visual hint for the snapshot pill that opened the modal? tiny dot or ring, so when modal closes the user sees where they came from.
maria: good idea. add a subtle pulse focus state for the triggering pill for 600ms on close. devs — will that be ok?
tareq: fine. keep it purely presentation (no extra DOM). we'll use an add/remove class with animation.
design-bot: Reminder: UX copy review queued (task UX-4981).
maria: thanks — closing loop after i update Figma. I'll also attach a short voiceover test plan so eden/tareq can validate. :thumbsup:
